learning_outcomes.text: Students master and can apply the following mathematical methods for solving engineering problems: Differential calculus for functions of several variables
Students master and can apply the following mathematical methods for solving engineering problems: Integral calculus for functions of several variables
Students master and can apply the following mathematical methods for solving engineering problems: Properties of Laplace and Fourier transformation
Students master and can apply the following mathematical methods for solving engineering problems: Function theory, especially residue calculation

syllabus_topics: Differential calculus for functions of several variables
Integral calculus for functions of several variables, especially volume integrals, curve integrals, surface integrals, and the integral theorems important for application
Properties of Laplace and Fourier transformation
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded upon successful completion of the module exam. The grade contributes 10/138 to the final grade.
